name: stress-test
title: Stress test
description: How many ships before it slows? Fly the Mammoth (Q and E, F fires, T beams) among two asteroids, and press 'Add a gunship' (top bar) to add AI gunships that hunt whatever they see — you or each other. The Performance section shows what each step costs. Built by scripts/stress-test.ts.

ui.lookFor: Press 'Add a gunship' (top bar) again and again and watch the step time beside it: once a step takes longer than its budget, the game falls behind real time. More in the inspector's Performance section.
